steps.text: Ruins of Chernobog 'District 14'
Sector Surface

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: What the hell?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Yeti Squad, why have you stopped firing? What are you waiting for?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: ...Dig out those ruins, huh?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Didn't you plant the Originium? Why not collapse the whole plate and wipe out Rhodes Island all at once?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Are you kidding? FrostNova is still down there!

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Then we'll deal with Rhodes Island. You guys keep digging. We'll be right there.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Not on this block! The superstructure in this sector is completely shredded. An untrained team fighting here could induce a total collapse!

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Wiping out Rhodes Island is a top priority. You take care of it.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: I'm not gonna argue with you. We'll fight what we gotta fight. Who decided on this priority anyway?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: It's obviously our most important strategic goal.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Were you thinking about strategic goals when you vented your anger on the Ursus?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: We'll do what we can. Give us some space.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Did you... communicate with Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: You're betraying the Movement!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (What's going on over there?)

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: (I think we have to fight.)

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: If you think communication is tantamount to betrayal then that's your prerogative.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: With that kind of tactical thinking, it's no wonder you're getting led around by the nose.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: ...Yetis! What are you up to?!

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: We outnumber you a hundred times over, don't be stupid!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: ...Come on, we fought the Ursus Standing Army like a million times, who's getting excited over a big angry mob?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Just you wait!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: (Static)

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Hey, Rhodes Island. We might have to teach those unruly bastards a lesson.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: You should probably stay out of it. We don't want to be accused of collaborating with the enemy.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh? Collaborating? What are you talking about?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Amiya, what happened in the ruins, and what's the official party line on it?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ......Nothing happened. We were fighting Yeti Squad and no other Reunion units joined the battle.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Acting? I'm a phenomenal actress.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What do you say we put on a show and then take care of these guys in the ensuing chaos?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Sounds good to me. What does your captain think?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Excuse me, sir. How should I call you?

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: ...Um, well, you're a really cute girl, but I'm not sure I'm ready for anything like that...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member B
steps.text: Ready for what? What are you thinking?!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member A
steps.text: Oh, sorry. I'm just playing around. You can call me Yeti #1, I guess.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All right, Mr. Yeti #1... We've got lives to save, don't we?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So let's subdue the Reunion units that could interfere with our rescue mission.

steps.name: Mr. Yeti #1
steps.text: Yeah. I'm plenty motivated now.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...And where exactly did you get that motivation?
